title: ELF Grape Ice Nicotine Pouches
description: ELF Grape Ice Nicotine Pouches blend sweet, fruity Grape flavour with a streak of cool Menthol for a clean and refreshing experience. Ideal for those who prefer a pouch with authentic fruity flavour coupled with a fresh, cool finish, these pouches deliver consistent satisfaction in a tobacco-free format. Each pouch sits discreetly under the upper lip and provides a gradual nicotine release over 30 to 45 minutes, with no smoke, vapour or odour. The pouches are slim, soft and made with plant-based fibres for all-day comfort. Each can contains 20 pouches and features a convenient catch lid for storing used pouches. Choose from 6mg, 12mg or 20mg strengths depending on your preference. How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, Suck or Swallow the pouches.
